request_summary: Point the CI hook job at the new hook-test runner with --require-bash so the three suite names are not duplicated between the workflow and the runner.
rationale: C2: bounded one-way door: deploy:.github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, deploy:.github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, deploy:declared:deployment — reduced-pipeline floor for ≤3 files in one real package; pipeline reach: no pipeline seat may edit .github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, so a pipeline lane could never finish this change — it is routed to the root session that ran this triage (or to the operator for any edit the root session's own grants refuse) and the handling is inline; the class above still states the change's weight (1 edit-target files / 0 package(s) (root pseudo-package excluded, Q1 2026-08-21) / 1 write-scope clusters / co-change unassessed / shape=brownfield)
done_oracle: The workflow's hook job runs `node scripts/run-hook-tests.js --require-bash` instead of naming the three bash scripts itself, so the suite list lives in exactly one place and a CI runner without bash fails instead of skipping.

seam_claims.note: The sdd-cache step; the two sibling steps above it are the duplicated suite list being replaced.

no_single_gate_reason: A GitHub Actions YAML step has no local runner; its correctness is decided by GitHub's parser at push time. The runner it now calls is verified separately by executing it in both of its branches.
